**NeuroAtlas**

**Subscription & Membership Management — Requirements (Draft)**

# **0\. Purpose & Business Model Overview**

This document scopes Subscription & Membership Management for NeuroAtlas, based on client confirmation that this is a B2C, subscription-only model. It was previously listed as Out of Scope for Phase 1 in the core requirement document; phase placement has now been confirmed (see below and Section 10.3).

- Phase placement: CONFIRMED — this scope is committed to the current delivery window. It is not deferred to September.

- Model: subscription-only. There is no separate hardware charge — the wearable band is included free with membership and ships automatically on signup. The only revenue line is the membership subscription.

- Purchase happens on the website (Stripe), not via native in-app purchase. The app consumes membership status; it does not process payment.

- This document covers the app-side and shared-logic scope only. Website checkout build is owned by the website team — see Section 8 for the coordination boundary.

# **1\. Decisions & Open Items**

The following tracks what has been confirmed and what still requires client input before development starts.

## **Confirmed**

| ✓ Phase Placement — Current Delivery Window Client has confirmed Subscription & Membership Management is committed to the current delivery phase — it is not deferred to September. Detail and dependency sequencing in Section 10.3. Note: this confirms WHEN this work happens; it does not resolve the open items below, which still need client answers regardless of phase timing. |
| :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

## **Still Open — Require Client Confirmation**

| Commitment structure — to confirm Client flagged that a minimum term (e.g., annual as default, and/or a minimum term on monthly) may be required to protect the free-band hardware cost, but has not confirmed the specific structure. Section 4 leaves an explicit hook for this; it must not be built until confirmed. |
| :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| Band retention/return policy on cancellation — to confirm Whether a cancelled member keeps or must return the free band is described by the client as "a policy point to confirm." This has no app-side logic impact directly, but may affect the cancellation confirmation copy and any admin-side tracking. Left as an open hook in Section 7 (Admin). |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

# **2\. Membership Plans & Pricing**

Single membership tier at launch. Additional tiers are a future consideration, not required for this phase.

| Plan   | Price                  | Trial              |
| :----- | :--------------------- | :----------------- |
| Annual | £180 / year (≈ £15/mo) | First 8 weeks free |

**Includes with the single membership:**

- Stress Age score and all daily-state metrics (Cognitive Load, Emotional Regulation, Recovery Capacity)

- Full NeuroLibrary — all modules and toolkits

- All briefings

- Free wearable band, shipped automatically at signup

**⚠ OUT OF SCOPE (current phase):** _"AI coach" is excluded from this list pending client clarification (Section 1)._

# **3\. Entitlement Model (Core Logic)**

Access is modelled as entitlements, not as two exclusive access paths. A user may hold one or more entitlement sources simultaneously; access is granted if ANY entitlement is currently active.

**Entitlement sources:**

- corporate_seat — granted via organisation invite code (existing Module 0.4 / 1.0 flow); tier \= Core / Elite / Bespoke

- beta_grant — existing beta/founding-member access, no payment

- individual_subscription — new: B2C membership purchased via website Stripe checkout

| FUNCTION resolve_entitlement(user): active_sources \= \[\] IF user.corporate_seat.status \== "active": active_sources.add("corporate_seat") IF user.beta_grant.status \== "active": active_sources.add("beta_grant") IF user.individual_subscription.status IN \["active", "trialing", "grace_period"\]: active_sources.add("individual_subscription") IF active_sources.is_empty(): RETURN { access: NONE } // Precedence: corporate seat takes precedence for tier/feature resolution // while active. Coexisting personal subscription is neither cancelled // nor charged-through; it is preserved in the background. IF "corporate_seat" IN active_sources: RETURN { access: FULL, tier_source: "corporate_seat", tier: user.corporate_seat.tier } ELSE: RETURN { access: FULL, tier_source: first(active_sources), tier: "membership" } // IMPORTANT: never charge individual_subscription and corporate_seat // concurrently as if both were being "used" — corporate precedence // means the personal subscription simply sits idle, not billed differently. |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

Corporate → personal conversion: when a corporate_seat is revoked or expires, the system re-evaluates entitlement on next check. If the user has an active individual_subscription, access continues uninterrupted under that entitlement. If not, the user drops to the locked/no-entitlement state and is prompted to subscribe (existing data is retained — see Section 4).

# **4\. Membership Lifecycle Logic**

Covers trial → paid conversion, cancellation, and failed payment (dunning) handling.

| ON checkout_complete(user, plan): user.individual_subscription.status \= "trialing" user.individual_subscription.trial_end \= now() \+ 8 WEEKS user.individual_subscription.plan \= plan // monthly | annual user.individual_subscription.payment_method \= captured_at_checkout // NOTE: minimum-term / commitment rule to be inserted here once confirmed (Section 1\) ON trial_end_reached(user): attempt_charge(user.individual_subscription.payment_method, plan.price) IF charge_success: user.individual_subscription.status \= "active" ELSE: user.individual_subscription.status \= "payment_failed" start_dunning(user) ON cancellation_requested(user): user.individual_subscription.status \= "cancel_pending" // access continues at full entitlement until current paid period ends user.individual_subscription.access_until \= current_period_end ON current_period_end_reached(user): IF user.individual_subscription.status \== "cancel_pending": user.individual_subscription.status \= "lapsed_readonly" ELSE IF payment_failed_and_retries_exhausted(user): user.individual_subscription.status \= "grace_period" THEN "lapsed_readonly" ON payment_failed(user): user.individual_subscription.status \= "grace_period" retry_schedule \= \[ day 1, day 3, day 7 \] // to confirm exact cadence with payment provider defaults IF all_retries_fail: user.individual_subscription.status \= "lapsed_readonly" // HARD RULES — do not violate: // 1\. Never hard-delete user data on lapse or cancellation. // 2\. Never cut access immediately on cancellation — always run to period end. // 3\. "lapsed_readonly" is a state, not a deletion — user keeps history // and can resubscribe at any time to restore full access. |
| :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

# **5\. Feature Access by Membership State**

| Membership State   | App Access                                                                           | Notes                                                               |
| :----------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Active / Trialing  | Full access — Stress Age, daily-state metrics, full Library, all toolkits, briefings | "AI coach" excluded — see Section 1                                 |
| Grace Period       | Full access retained temporarily                                                     | Dunning retries running in background                               |
| Lapsed / Read-only | Own history \+ basic daily-state view only                                           | Library, toolkits, briefings locked; resubscribe restores instantly |
| No Entitlement     | "Membership required" locked state                                                   | Prompts web checkout; no in-app purchase CTA                        |

# **6\. User Stories — Module 13: Subscription & Membership (App-Side)**

App-side scope only. Website checkout flow is detailed separately in Section 9\.

**■** App Team ownership **■** Website Team ownership

## **13.1 — Membership Status Display**

| ID                      | 13.1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Membership Status Display                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **User Story**          | As a member, I want to see my current membership status in the app so I know what I have access to and when my plan renews.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Profile screen shows: plan name, status (Active / Trialing / Grace Period / Lapsed), renewal or trial-end date. Status reflects the resolved entitlement from Section 3 (corporate seat shown distinctly from individual subscription if both exist). "Manage membership" action deep-links to the website billing portal (not handled in-app).                 |
| **Edge Cases**          | User has both corporate_seat and individual_subscription active → show corporate as the active source, with a note that a personal subscription also exists. Entitlement sync delayed/stale → show last-known status with a subtle "syncing" indicator rather than a hard error. No entitlement at all → this screen routes to the locked state (13.2) instead. |

## **13.2 — Membership Required (Locked State)**

| ID                      | 13.2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| :---------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Membership Required Locked State                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| **User Story**          | As a user without an active entitlement, I want a clear, calm explanation of what membership unlocks so I understand why a feature is locked without feeling blocked or nagged.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Locked features show a minimal, non-intrusive state — no modal interruptions, no repeated pop-ups (per luxury UX standard). State explains what membership includes and provides a single CTA that opens the website checkout in an external browser/webview. No native purchase button is shown — CTA routes to web only, per App Review compliance decision. |
| **Edge Cases**          | User taps CTA while offline → show "Connect to the internet to continue" rather than a broken link. User completes checkout on web, returns to app before entitlement sync completes → show a brief "activating membership" state rather than the locked state, until sync confirms.                                                                           |

## **13.3 — Post-Subscribe Welcome**

| ID                      | 13.3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| :---------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Sub Feature**         | First-Time Membership Active Welcome                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **User Story**          | As a new member, I want a brief acknowledgment when my membership activates so I feel confident the purchase worked and know where to start.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | On first entitlement sync confirming individual_subscription \= active/trialing, app opens to Home (daily-state card) with a brief, tasteful "Membership active" acknowledgment. Acknowledgment is shown once only (first activation), not on every app open. No celebratory/gamified animation — calm, premium tone consistent with brand. |
| **Edge Cases**          | User subscribes on web without the app installed → standard app-install deep-link flow applies (per prior deep-link discussion); welcome state shows on first app open post-install. Sync confirms activation while user is already in-app → show as a subtle inline banner, not a full-screen interrupt.                                   |

## **13.4 — Entitlement Sync Handling**

| ID                      | 13.4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| :---------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Background Entitlement Sync                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **User Story**          | As the system, I need the app to reliably reflect entitlement changes (activation, lapse, cancellation, grace period) so feature access is always accurate without requiring the user to log out/in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | App checks entitlement status on app foreground and at defined intervals in background, per shared entitlement layer (Section 10). State transitions (active → grace_period → lapsed_readonly, or reactivation) apply immediately on next sync, gating/ungating features accordingly. Sync failures do not immediately revoke access — a grace window applies before downgrading UI to avoid punishing users for transient network issues. |
| **Edge Cases**          | Sync provider (entitlement layer) outage → app retains last-known-good entitlement state for a bounded grace window, then shows a neutral "unable to verify membership" state rather than falsely locking a paying member out. User subscribes on web on a different device than their primary app device → sync must resolve via shared user identity, not device.                                                                        |

## **13.5 — Corporate-to-Personal Conversion Prompt**

| ID                      | 13.5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| :---------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Corporate Access Ending — Conversion Prompt                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **User Story**          | As a user whose corporate seat is ending, I want to be informed in advance and offered a smooth path to a personal membership so I don't lose access or my data unexpectedly.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | When corporate_seat is flagged as expiring (or revoked) and no active individual_subscription exists, show an advance, non-alarming notice with a CTA to subscribe personally via the website. If the user converts, their existing history, sessions, and journal data are preserved and continue under the new entitlement — no data reset. If corporate access ends and the user does not convert, they move to the no-entitlement locked state (13.2), not lapsed_readonly (that state is reserved for a lapsed personal subscription specifically). |
| **Edge Cases**          | Corporate seat revoked with zero notice (e.g., org offboarding) → conversion prompt still shown at next app open, just without the advance-warning lead time. User already has an active individual_subscription running alongside the corporate seat → no prompt needed; entitlement simply continues under the personal subscription automatically per Section 3 logic.                                                                                                                                                                                |

# **7\. Admin Panel — Membership & Entitlement Management**

Extends existing Module 12 (Admin) / 12.5 (User Management) rather than introducing a separate admin area.

## **13.6 — Admin: Membership & Entitlement Management**

| ID                      | 13.6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| :---------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Admin — Membership & Entitlement Management (extends 12.5)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| **User Story**          | As a support/content admin, I want to view and manage each user's entitlement and subscription status so I can support billing queries, corporate access, and comps without engineering involvement.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Admin can view, per user: all active entitlement sources (corporate_seat / beta_grant / individual_subscription), current status, and next renewal or lapse date. Admin can manually grant or revoke access (e.g., founding members, comps, corporate seats). Admin can issue and revoke organisation invite codes (existing capability, surfaced alongside individual subscription data for a unified view). Admin can view payment status (active, past due, in grace period, failed) as reported by the payment provider; refund actions themselves are initiated via the payment provider, with resulting status reflected here. Admin actions are logged (who granted/revoked what, and when) for audit purposes. |
| **Edge Cases**          | Admin manually revokes access for a user mid-billing-cycle → does not automatically trigger a refund; refund remains a separate, explicit payment-provider action. Conflicting manual grant vs. live subscription state (e.g., admin grants access to a user whose subscription later lapses) → manual grant and subscription are tracked as independent entitlement sources per Section 3, not overwritten. Band retention/return policy on cancellation → hook reserved here for a future "band status" field once client confirms policy (see Section 1).                                                                                                                                                           |

# **8\. Website Team Coordination Boundary**

Since purchase happens on the web, delivery splits across two teams. The table below is a quick-reference summary; full user stories for the website side are detailed in Section 9, colour-coded to distinguish ownership at a glance.

| Website Team Owns                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | App Team Owns (this document)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Plan selection UI & pricing page Stripe subscription setup (8-week trial \+ auto-conversion) Payment capture & processing Free-band shipping address collection at checkout Call webhook to send data to Neuroatlas system for subscription details(Ex: Purchase, Renew, Expiry, Cancelation, Grace period, Payment failed etc) | User/login system (existing auth — see Section 10\) Consuming entitlement status in-app Feature gating by entitlement (Sections 4–5) In-app membership states (Section 6\) Admin panel (Section 7\) Create webhook for subscription details(Ex: Purchase, Renew, Expiry, Cancelation, Grace period, Payment failed etc) |

# **9\. User Stories — Website Team (WEB.1–WEB.6)**

Provided for shared visibility and coordination. The website team owns build execution and may refine implementation detail, but these should be validated against the entitlement and lifecycle logic in Sections 3–4 so both sides implement consistent behaviour.

**■** App Team ownership **■** Website Team ownership

## **13.W1 — Plan Selection & Pricing Page**

| ID                      | 13.W1                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| :---------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Plan Selection & Pricing Page (Website)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **User Story**          | As a prospective member, I want to see membership plans and pricing clearly on the website so I can decide whether to subscribe.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Pricing page displays the single membership tier, monthly (£18) and annual (£180) pricing, and the 8-week free trial messaging. "AI coach" is NOT listed as a feature until the Section 1 open item is resolved. Page includes a clear CTA into checkout (13.W2).                                                                                                 |
| **Edge Cases**          | Pricing or trial terms change → page must read from a single source of truth (shared plan config), not be hardcoded separately from actual Stripe billing setup, to avoid marketing/billing drift. A user with an already-active membership lands on this page (e.g., via an old marketing link) → show their current status instead of a duplicate purchase CTA. |

## **13.W2 — Stripe Subscription Checkout**

| ID                      | 13.W2                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| :---------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Sub Feature**         | Stripe Subscription Checkout (Trial \+ Auto-Conversion)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **User Story**          | As a prospective member, I want to complete signup and payment setup on the website so my membership and free band both activate correctly.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Checkout collects plan selection (monthly/annual) and payment method (captured upfront), and creates a Stripe subscription with an 8-week trial before first charge. On trial end, Stripe auto-converts to the paid subscription per the Section 4 lifecycle logic. Successful checkout triggers entitlement creation (individual_subscription \= trialing) via the shared entitlement layer (Section 10.2). Commitment/minimum-term structure is applied at checkout once confirmed (Section 1\) — do not build this part until confirmed. |
| **Edge Cases**          | Payment method declined at checkout → clear inline error; no partial account or entitlement is created. User abandons checkout after account creation but before payment confirmation → account exists but no entitlement is granted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## **13.W3 — Free Band Shipping Address Capture**

| ID                      | 13.W3                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Free Band Shipping Address Capture                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| **User Story**          | As a new member, I want to provide my shipping address during checkout so my free band ships automatically.                                                                                                                                               |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Checkout requires a shipping address before signup can complete. Address is passed to fulfilment on successful checkout. Address remains editable post-purchase via the billing portal (13.W6) up until the band has shipped.                             |
| **Edge Cases**          | Invalid or incomplete address → checkout cannot complete until resolved. Address entered outside the primary UK market → flag for manual review rather than silently failing (confirm international shipping scope with client if this becomes relevant). |

## **13.W4 — Shared Account Creation / Identity Linking**

| ID                      | 13.W4                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| :---------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Shared Account Creation / Identity Linking                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **User Story**          | As a user signing up on the website, I want my website account to be the same account I use in the app so I don't have to create two logins.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Website checkout creates or links an account into the app's existing auth system (email \+ password / SSO), per the identity model in Section 10.1. If a website signup email matches an existing app account, checkout links to that existing account rather than creating a duplicate. First app login after web signup uses the same credentials — no separate in-app registration step required. |
| **Edge Cases**          | Signup email doesn't match an existing corporate SSO account on the same email → prompt the user to sign in via their existing method rather than creating a conflicting duplicate account. User changes their email on one side (website account settings vs. app) → change must propagate through the shared identity system, not create drift between the two.                                    |

## **13.W5 — Entitlement Publish to Shared Layer**

| ID                      | 13.W5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Entitlement Publish to Shared Layer                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| **User Story**          | As the system, I need subscription state changes made on the website to be published to the shared entitlement layer so the app reflects accurate access without delay.                                                                                                                                               |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Every subscription state change (trial start, conversion, payment failure, grace period, cancellation, lapse, reactivation) triggers an entitlement update via the shared layer (Section 10.2). Publishing is event-driven (e.g., Stripe webhook → entitlement layer) in near real time, not on a slow polling cycle. |
| **Edge Cases**          | Webhook delivery failure or retry → entitlement layer reconciles against Stripe's own state on a backup schedule, so a single dropped event doesn't permanently desync access. Duplicate webhook delivery (Stripe's normal retry behaviour) → updates must be idempotent, not double-applied.                         |

## **13.W6 — Self-Serve Billing Portal**

| ID                      | 13.W6                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| :---------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sub Feature**         | Self-Serve Billing Portal                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| **User Story**          | As a member, I want to manage my membership — view billing, update payment method, change plan, or cancel — from the website so I don't need to contact support for routine changes.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Acceptance Criteria** | Billing portal is reachable from website account settings and via the "Manage membership" link surfaced in-app (13.1). Supports: view current plan/status, update payment method, switch monthly ⇄ annual, and cancel. Cancellation follows the Section 4 lifecycle (runs to period end, then grace, then read-only) — this portal never triggers an immediate cutoff.         |
| **Edge Cases**          | User attempts to cancel during an active minimum-term commitment (once confirmed, Section 1\) → portal must reflect the actual earliest cancellation-effective date, not allow an earlier one. User cancels then resubscribes within the same billing period → must not be double-charged; reactivation logic should check for an existing, not-yet-lapsed subscription first. |

# **10\. Shared Dependencies Requiring Confirmation**

## **10.1 Identity / System of Record**

The app already has its own backend authentication (email \+ password, plus Corporate SSO via OIDC), with org_id and tier already linked to user_id at account-linking time (existing Module 1.0). This makes the app's auth system the natural candidate for system of record, with the website creating or linking accounts into it — rather than the website standing up a separate identity provider.

**⚠ PENDING CONFIRMATION:** _Not finalized — requires Mobile Architect's confirmation before the website team builds against it, since it means exposing account creation/lookup to the website checkout flow. This is an API surface decision, not just a policy one._

## **10.2 Entitlement Sync Layer**

Client has suggested RevenueCat (paired with Stripe) as a shared entitlement layer so both website and app read one source of truth rather than each side building sync independently. RevenueCat supports custom auth backends via its own App User ID — it does not require Firebase, so it is compatible with the app's existing auth system per 10.1.

**⚠ PENDING CONFIRMATION:** _Pending Mobile Architect's integration-effort. Not committed in this document._

# **11\. Explicitly Out of Scope (This Phase)**

- AI Coach — pending client clarification (Section 1); not to be built or represented as live until resolved.

- Native in-app purchase (Apple/Google IAP) — model is web-first by client decision.

- Multiple membership tiers — single tier at launch only; multi-tier is a future consideration.

- Per-session or usage caps — none apply to the single membership tier.

# **Core pages (pre-launch)**

## **1\. Home page**

The complete brand story in short form, leading to two clear next steps.

- **What NeuroAtlas is:** a wearable band and app that work as one system
- **The problem it solves:** pressure affects performance before you feel it
- **The core method:** measure, intervene, measure
- Introduction to the **NA·01 band**
- Overview of the five toolkit families
- How NeuroAtlas differs from existing trackers and calming devices
- **Who it is built for:** individuals and organisations
- Data privacy commitment
- Founder introduction and current status
- **Calls to action:** request access, or enquire about a corporate pilot

## **2\. The NA·01 band**

Full detail on the wearable device.

- **What the band measures:** heart rate variability, breathing, stress load
- What it deliberately does not do, and why
- Materials, comfort, battery life and charging
- Accuracy and validation
- How the band and app work together
- Answers to common concerns about wearing another device

## **3\. How it works**

The method explained in full.

- **Measure:** continuous reading of the nervous system
- **Intervene:** short protocols usable during the working day
- **Measure again:** the change shown as a result, not a feeling
- Pattern recognition and how the system anticipates pressure points
- A practical example of the loop in use
- An honest statement of what the product does not claim to do

## **4\. Inside the app**

What the user gets on their phone.

- The daily dashboard and readiness reading
- The NeuroLibrary and how content is organised
- Boardroom Mode as the flagship feature
- Journal and daily check-in
- Progress tracking over time
- Optional health integrations
- Availability on iOS and Android

## **5\. The science**

The credibility page.

- **The three areas the protocols draw on:** autonomic regulation, prefrontal-limbic control, neuroplastic conditioning
- What heart rate variability is and why it is the right signal
- The limits of standard wearable stress readings, and how the closed loop addresses them
- Research references and methodology
- Scientific advisors

## **6\. For organisations**

The corporate buyer's track.

- The cost of burnout and staff turnover, framed as business risk
- **Data privacy:** individuals keep their own data, leadership sees only anonymous trends
- What the leadership dashboard reports
- How a pilot programme runs and what is reviewed at the end
- The business case for decision-makers
- Security, compliance and data ownership on contract exit
- **Call to action:** book a corporate presentation

## **7\. Privacy and your data**

Separate from the legal policy, because this is a selling point.

- What is collected, stored and never shared
- The boundary between individual and employer access
- Encryption, retention, deletion and data export rights

## **8\. About us**

- The founder's story and what prompted NeuroAtlas
- **The core belief:** performance is limited by the nervous system, not talent
- Vision and mission
- The combination of neuroscience with established regulation practices
- Where the company is today: London, pilot programmes, 2026 launch
- Team

## **9\. Request access**

The main conversion page for individuals.

- Positioned as an application rather than a sign-up
- **Short form:** name, role, organisation, sector, reason for interest
- What happens next and when to expect a response
- Separate entry for those who already hold an invite code

## **10\. Contact**

- Working email address
- Separate routes for general, corporate, press and support enquiries
- Location and expected response time

## **11\. FAQ**

Built around the questions this audience will actually ask.

- How this differs from a wellness or meditation app
- How it compares to existing trackers
- Whether an employer can see individual results
- Session length and daily time commitment
- Whether the app works without the band
- Availability, pricing and waiting list timing
- Divided into individual and organisation questions

##

## **12\. Journal**

- Articles on focus, pressure and recovery
- Founder viewpoints
- Pilot stories, once available

## **13\. Legal and utility pages**

- Privacy policy
- Terms of use
- Cookie policy
- Accessibility statement
- 404 page
- Form and newsletter confirmation pages
